description: Change a review agent. Change a review agent's instructions, threshold, polarity, trigger, the connector that runs it, whether it blocks, or switch it off. Its `key` is fixed. Earlier evals keep the verdict they were given.

agentId.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

polarity.description: Which direction is good. Confidence is `higher_is_better`; risk is `lower_is_better`. For a `boolean` agent, `lower_is_better` means a 1 (yes, an issue was found) fails.

trigger.description: When a review agent runs — on every `push` to a trail's linked pull request, or only when a review is requested (`manual`).

valueType.description: How a review agent's value reads — a `score` from 0 to 100, or a `boolean` signal submitted as 1 (yes) or 0 (no).

name: ops_review_agents_update
